F-13 / F-14: In-app messages are broadcast or targeted per user from the back office (Support Ops → In-app Messages); the push channels (in-app / email / SMS / app push) are defined item by item in the Functional Specification.

F-16 App Download: the download entry, version number, changelog and package URL are maintained in the back office (System Config → App Release / App Version Log); the front-end download page reads the latest version automatically. For the biometric-unlock interaction demo, see

F-18 Market Selection: multi-market grouping, watchlist pairs and fiat price conversion are all implemented. In the prototype the watchlist is in local state; the production version persists it per user, and fiat rates refresh on a schedule from a back-office-configured rate source.
